Each card is a self-contained example. Click through for the code and the
rendered result. Everything is drawn by [vellumplot](https://r-vellum.github.io/vellumplot/)
on the [vellum](https://r-vellum.github.io/vellum/) engine, which solves the
whole figure before it draws any of it.

::: {.stories-intro}
**Stories** come first: pieces that start from a real dataset and end with
something learned from it, from 26 seasons of NBA shots and 306 million census
points to a summer of Bundesliga transfers and Germany's districts by age and
income. [Show only the stories](#category=Stories). The rest of the gallery is
organised by technique; pick a category on the right to filter.
:::
